nextActions: Build a read-only LobeHub adapter that refreshes these counts and root statuses.
Create AzA tables or typed records for agent, skill, session, memory_source, artifact, and promoted_fact.
Connect Codex as the coding executor so it can inspect sources and attach evidence back to LobeHub/AzA.
Add per-agent access labels before using memory to route work automatically.
Reconcile VANTA-Brain projections against AzA records instead of treating vault files as canonical.

roots.role: Large external/local skill catalog for specialized agent capabilities.
roots.indexPolicy: Index metadata, capability, owner, path, version, and allowed agents. Do not inline full skill bodies unless explicitly approved.

roots.role: Codex-local skill catalog and system skills.
roots.indexPolicy: Index entrypoints, source roots, skill purpose, and safe invocation metadata for the Codex coding-agent lane.
Index agent identity, role, allowed tools, memory scope, task lane, and source path.

roots.role: Hermes reusable skills and domain-specific procedures.
roots.indexPolicy: Index skill metadata and domain lane; keep execution files in Hermes until promoted or refactored.

roots.role: Hermes session archive and runtime evidence.
roots.indexPolicy: Index session metadata, summaries, decisions, artifacts, and promoted facts. Avoid dumping raw sessions into global memory.
Index memory file metadata and conflicts first; promote verified durable facts into AzA records.

roots.role: Codex memory summary, rollout summaries, skill memory, and ad-hoc memory extensions.
roots.indexPolicy: Index summaries, rollout identifiers, evidence pointers, and current-goal relevance. Treat as coding-agent memory, not the whole brain.

routingPolicy.description: Architecture decisions, GTM strategy, verified paths, app inventory, project status, and customer proof should become canonical AzA records.
Skill bodies and tool procedures stay in their native root unless the user approves copying or refactoring them.
Raw sessions remain runtime evidence. AzA stores session metadata, summaries, decisions, artifacts, and promoted facts.
Every record should include agent, project, session, sensitivity, allowed readers, and allowed actions.
VANTA-Brain receives reviewed markdown projections only after AzA has source path, timestamp, owner, and verification status.

source: read-only filesystem inventory of local agent, skill, session, and memory roots

verdict.summary: Use AzA as one canonical typed memory and retrieval layer, while preserving granular per-agent skills, prompts, tool rules, sessions, and working memory in their native runtime roots.
verdict.reason: The machine already has multiple large specialized skill and session stores. Copying them into separate full brains would fragment durable knowledge; flattening them into one unscoped blob would erase permissions, ownership, and agent specialization.
